emma: Marketing needs a small, reproducible bench bundle for launch content. Requirements: cold vs warmed curves, fp16 vs q4f16, p50/p95/p99, cost/token, 20 sample outputs/workload, heatmap PNG, and a README marketing can copy. Target: 48h.

ben: Ack. Proposed matrix: redwood-1-small (fp16) + redwood-1-small-q4f16; workloads = short (<=64t), chat (6 turns), long-summary (~2k); warmup buckets = 0,200,500,1000; seeds = 5; shards = 3. We'll emit CSV + JSONL + sample_outputs/.

kai: Scheduling two job groups now (fp16 + q4f16). Output prefix = s3://redwood-artifacts/launch2026/bench-2481200001/. We'll include docker/image digests + bench-runner SHA for reproducibility. ETA ~12h. Any objections to 3 repeats instead of 5? saves time.

emma: Keep 5 seeds for marketing credibility. 3 shards OK. Make sure README includes a 1-command reproduce line and the marketing blurb under marketing-blurb.txt. Tag artifacts with "launch2026-marketing".

sara: For sample outputs pick varied prompts (funny, technical, instruction-following) and flag ~6 edge cases for review. Put flagged_examples/ and include generation params.

ci-bot: [CI] Job queued: bench-2481200001-fp16. Start in ~10m.

ben: Noted. Run command example:
./bench-runner --model redwood-1-small --variant q4f16 --workload chat --warmup 500 --seeds 5 --shards 3 --out s3://redwood-artifacts/launch2026/bench-2481200001/q4f16/chat/ --record-trace

ben: Will upload README.md + presigned_links.txt and heatmap PNG. I'll ping when artifacts land.
